title: Pandolfi's uncle a founding member of the OSS

tellings.quote: >> And uh he wants the information and it's shut down by Dr. Pandolfe, who by the way, his uncle Louis Pandolfe was a founding member of the OSS.

plain: A Dr. Pandolfi who is said to have blocked someone's request for information has an uncle, Louis Pandolfi, who was a founding member of the OSS, the US wartime spy service that came before the CIA. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this, as part of a story that also involves the researcher Jacques Vallée. Simosa raises the family tie to suggest the man who shut the request down has deep roots in the intelligence world.
